chunks: And Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, peace be upon him, who said:
One is not stripped in a hadd punishment, nor is one stretched out, meaning extended.
And he said: The adulterer is struck in the condition in which he is found; if he is found unclothed, he is struck unclothed, and if he is found with his clothes on, he is struck with his clothes on.

key_terms.الزَّانِي: the adulterer; the one guilty of zina
key_terms.لَا يُجَرَّدُ: he is not stripped of clothing
key_terms.لَا يُشْبَحُ: he is not stretched out or extended

ai.seo_question: How should the hadd punishment for zina be carried out with respect to clothing and bodily restraint?
ai.summary: This hadith states rulings regarding the manner of carrying out a legal punishment in cases of zina. It prohibits stripping or stretching the person during the hadd, and it instructs that the adulterer is punished in the state in which he is found, whether clothed or unclothed.
